Return only properties in SUBMITTED.claims, copying their property names exactly. Use documents for the exact submitted product/model or listed system, not a generic certificate. Read status notices independently of data sheet values. A manufacturer's family-wide status notice can apply to a member model without printing its full order code; establish that family relationship using the submitted label and product/model names. An unrelated product's values or active status cannot establish this product's status. Quote the family notice when it applies. Do not use certification/category codes or a catalog's Updated timestamp as a document revision. Prefer the data sheet linked by the manufacturer's product page over a standalone search hit. For each property, first locate a short verbatim quote stating its current value. Copy the value from that quote, preserving any numeric bound. Never take the value from a different passage than its quote. A related limit is not evidence for a different number. Omit values you cannot support with that exact quote.
